searchParams.shape: { destination: string, checkIn: string, checkOut: string, guests: number }
searchParams.description: User's current search criteria. Drives result filtering and is echoed in later sections for context.

filteredHotelIds.description: Ids of hotels currently visible in the results grid after the last search action.

selectedHotelId.description: The hotel the user has focused for detail and potential booking. Cleared only on full reset.

selectedRoomId.description: Specific room/rate id chosen inside the selected hotel. Required to enable checkout preview progression.

currentOperationState.description: Coarse operation lifecycle for the booking intent. Values: intake, results, detail, checkout-preview, checkout-valid, payment-pending-demo, payment-failed-demo. Used by future Operation Map views.

lastAction.description: Most recent action name + summary for debugging and for the sticky panel log.
